studio.title: SEMINARIO 11 — Software Engineering Studio
studio.weeklyRule: design → model → implement → test → document → defend

commonCore.title: Class, object and instance
commonCore.oop: Class vs object vs instance; identity and state
commonCore.uml: UML class box: name, attributes, operations
commonCore.evidence: One class, two instances and UML V1

commonCore.title: Constructors
commonCore.oop: Valid initial state and constructor parameters

commonCore.title: Inheritance
commonCore.oop: Generalization with a real is-a relationship

commonCore.title: Polymorphism and abstraction
commonCore.evidence: Common operation implemented in two types

commonCore.title: Debugging and refactoring
commonCore.oop: Find defects; improve names, cohesion and duplication

commonCore.title: Architecture defense
commonCore.oop: Explain state, flow, relationships and design decisions

sprints.title: Problem + MVP
sprints.goal: Define user, problem, input/process/output and minimum useful feature.

sprints.title: Data model + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model domain objects before interface logic.

sprints.title: Interface prototype
sprints.goal: Build semantic HTML and responsive layout.

sprints.title: OOP integration
sprints.goal: Implement domain classes and connect them to DOM events.

sprints.title: Persistence + validation
sprints.goal: Validate inputs and persist meaningful state.

sprints.title: Testing
sprints.goal: Test valid, invalid and boundary scenarios.

sprints.title: Refactor + accessibility
sprints.goal: Improve structure, naming, reuse and UI states.

sprints.title: Release + defense
sprints.goal: Publish MVP and defend architecture live.

sprints.title: Question + dataset
sprints.goal: Define one answerable question and obtain a suitable dataset.

sprints.title: Pipeline + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model Dataset, Cleaner, Analyzer and Report responsibilities.

sprints.title: Load + inspect
sprints.goal: Read data, identify types, nulls and quality issues.

sprints.title: OOP analysis layer
sprints.goal: Move reusable analysis behavior into classes.

sprints.title: Statistics + visualization
sprints.goal: Calculate descriptive measures and create justified plots.

sprints.title: Validation
sprints.goal: Check assumptions, edge cases and reproducibility.

sprints.title: Refactor + report
sprints.goal: Separate data, analysis and presentation responsibilities.

sprints.title: Release + defense
sprints.goal: Present evidence-based conclusions and defend code architecture.

sprints.title: Asset + threat scope
sprints.goal: Define what is protected and only defensive, authorized scenarios.

sprints.title: Security objects + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model User, Role, Session, Validator and AuditLog.

sprints.title: Validation layer
sprints.goal: Implement allow-list validation and safe error handling.

sprints.title: OOP security services
sprints.goal: Separate authentication/authorization simulation from UI.

sprints.title: Logging + least privilege
sprints.goal: Record security-relevant events and enforce role boundaries.

sprints.title: Defensive testing
sprints.goal: Test expected misuse without attacking external systems.

sprints.title: Hardening + refactor
sprints.goal: Reduce exposed state, duplicate checks and ambiguous privileges.

sprints.title: Security review + defense
sprints.goal: Explain risks, mitigations and residual limitations.

sprints.title: Geometry requirement
sprints.goal: Define dimensions, parameters and expected generated object.

sprints.title: Geometry objects + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model Shape, Solid, Transform and Assembly.

sprints.title: Primitive generator
sprints.goal: Create parameter-driven base geometry.

sprints.title: OOP transformations
sprints.goal: Encapsulate translation, rotation, scale or extrusion behavior.

sprints.title: Composition
sprints.goal: Build a larger object from reusable parts.

sprints.title: Validation
sprints.goal: Reject invalid dimensions and verify geometric constraints.

sprints.title: Refactor + export
sprints.goal: Improve reuse and create a consistent export/render flow.

sprints.title: Demo + defense
sprints.goal: Change a parameter live and explain architecture.

sprints.title: System requirement
sprints.goal: Define sensor input, decision logic, actuator output and safety state.

sprints.title: Automation objects + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model Sensor, Controller, Actuator and System.

sprints.title: Simulation
sprints.goal: Simulate sensor readings and deterministic outputs before hardware.

sprints.title: OOP control layer
sprints.goal: Implement object responsibilities and controller behavior.

sprints.title: State machine + fail-safe
sprints.goal: Handle transitions, invalid readings and safe fallback.

sprints.title: Integration testing
sprints.goal: Test multiple input sequences and expected actuator responses.

sprints.title: Hardware/advanced simulation
sprints.goal: Connect target hardware when available or strengthen simulation.

sprints.title: Demo + defense
sprints.goal: Run scenario live and defend object/state architecture.
